map.MPN-10 症状评估量表 + DIPSS 预后评分，评估骨髓纤维化症状负荷与预: MPN-10 symptom scale plus DIPSS prognostic score, evaluating myelofibrosis symptom burden and prognostic risk
map.MPN-10 量表评估症状负荷（0–100 分，≥20 干预）: The MPN-10 scale assesses symptom burden (0-100 points, intervene at >=20)
map.DIPSS 定预后风险（低危~185月 / 高危~16月）: DIPSS sets prognostic risk (low risk around 185 months / high risk around 16 months)
map.症状+预后双维指导 JAK2 抑制剂与移植决策: Symptoms plus prognosis guide both JAK2 inhibitor and transplant decisions
map.：DIPSS：年龄≥60(+1)、HGB<100(+1)、外周血原始≥1%(+1: DIPSS: age >= 60 (+1), HGB < 100 (+1), peripheral blasts >= 1% (+1), WBC > 25 (+1), constitutional symptoms (+1). 0-1 low risk, 2 intermediate-1, 3 intermediate-2, 4-5 high risk. MPN-10 has 10 items scored 0-10 each, with a total of 20 or more indicating a moderate or worse symptom burden, where a JAK2 inhibitor is suggested.
map.：例（年龄<60、HGB=105、原始=2%、WBC=15、无体质症状、MPN-: Example (age < 60, HGB=105, blasts=2%, WBC=15, no constitutional symptoms, MPN-10=0): DIPSS = 0 (age) + 0 (symptoms) + 0 (HGB >= 100, no points) + 1 (blasts >= 1) + 0 (WBC <= 25) = 1 point -> low-risk group (median survival about 185 months); MPN-10 shows no symptom burden, so observe for now. If MPN-10 >= 20, add a JAK2 inhibitor to improve symptoms.
map.MPN-10 和 DIPSS 哪个先决治疗？: Which Comes First for Treatment Decisions, MPN-10 or DIPSS?
map.两者互补：DIPSS 定「该不该移植/强化」，MPN-10 定「症状要不要药」。: The two complement each other: DIPSS decides whether to transplant or intensify therapy, MPN-10 decides whether symptoms need medication. Even with low-risk DIPSS, an MPN-10 >= 20 still justifies a JAK2 inhibitor to improve splenomegaly and symptoms.
map.思路相近但适用时点不同：IPSS-MF 用于初诊含年龄，DIPSS 用于已诊断后: The idea is similar but the timing differs: IPSS-MF is used at initial diagnosis and includes age, while DIPSS re-stratifies after diagnosis (adding dynamic items such as platelets and transfusion). Report both systems for the same patient to cross-check.
